title: Engineers are returning to their tools
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code appear in a growing share of stories.
expect: If true, the share of stories mentioning Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix or VS Code should be at least 1.2x higher in the latest 12 months than in all earlier stories since 2006 (pooled) (1.05x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code share of stories

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
